audience: ecommerce shippers who print labels and track parcels with Starshipit

useCases.title: List orders waiting to be shipped
useCases.text: The AI lists unshipped orders with addresses, items, packages and carrier, or a summary of orders by status with account-wide counts.

useCases.title: Find an order and track its parcel
useCases.text: The AI searches by order number, tracking number, customer reference or recipient name, then returns the status, carrier and tracking events of the shipment.

useCases.title: Quote shipping rates for a parcel
useCases.text: The AI quotes service names and prices from your enabled couriers for a destination and parcels, and lists delivery services. Nothing is bought or printed.

useCases.title: Review shipped orders and submitted manifests
useCases.text: The AI lists shipped orders with tracking status, carrier and manifest, and manifests sent to carriers with package and consignment counts.

useCases.title: Create an order or change an unshipped one
useCases.text: The AI creates an unshipped order, or changes addresses, carrier, items, packages, reference or note of one. It checks for an existing order number first and prints no label.

useCases.title: Tag unshipped orders, for example as fragile
useCases.text: The AI adds up to 10 tags to an unshipped order. A tag that does not exist yet is created.
